subjects.b-panorama-bay: a 19-metre stretch (four pilaster bays) of the long facade of the Panorama hypermarket at the Le Tre Mura shopping centre in Pistoia: cream-white rendered wall, tall square terracotta-red pilasters at both sides joined at the top by a projecting pergola-like cornice of red beams, a band of tall glass panels with dark frames between them, slim cypress trees in front, flat roof, no sign
subjects.b-panorama-entrance: the main entrance of the Panorama hypermarket at the Le Tre Mura shopping centre in Pistoia: a big recessed glazed entrance with sliding doors and red door frames under a projecting canopy, framed by tall terracotta-red pilasters and a pergola-like cornice of red beams, cream-white walls, and above it on the flat roof a big red sign reading PANORAMA
